description: Wearable wellness-device brand founded in 2015 by Jessica Charles, selling red light therapy, PEMF and molecular hydrogen belts, wraps and mats for recovery, sleep and body sculpting, with affiliate and referral programs that pay cash for referred purchases.

evidence.summary: Nushape's official affiliates page runs a referral program paying a flat $50 cash for each referral that completes a purchase, paid via PayPal in the first week of the following month. Its FAQ answers the question 'Is there a limit to how much I can earn?' with 'There is no limit to the amount you can earn' (new-customer referrals only, self-referrals excluded), so the commission cap is recorded as uncapped. Top partners unlock ambassador status after 10 referral sales, with free product and increased commissions.

Nushape's Awin merchant profile for the Nushape LLC Affiliate Program offers a 5% referral fee for orders coming through an affiliate link, with a 30-day cookie and in-house affiliate management, and publishes hello@nushape.com as the program contact. The profile notes the program also runs on Social Snowball/ShareASale and voids double-attributed transactions.

Nushape's partner page describes the brand as a trailblazer in red light therapy founded by Jessica Charles in 2015, making wearable red light, PEMF and molecular hydrogen devices (belts, mats, wraps and the NeuroWrap), and quotes a 10% commission for hospitality/spa partners — a third, partner-specific figure, so the consumer affiliate rate used here is the Awin-published 5%.

name: Nushape

reasons.compensation: The Awin rate is a modest 5%, but the in-house referral program pays a flat $50 per completed purchase on high-ticket devices, and the official FAQ states there is no limit on earnings.
reasons.contact_access: Instant enrollment on the brand's own page plus a published program email (hello@nushape.com) on its Awin profile.
reasons.credibility: Operating since 2015 with a distinctive wearable-device line and programs listed on a major network (Awin).
reasons.niche_fit: Wearable red light and PEMF devices sit squarely in the recovery, sleep and biohacking content wellness creators already make.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Anyone can join the referral program today and share a link immediately; the Awin program is also open for application.
reasons.ugc_evidence: An open referral program explicitly aimed at influencers, doctors and fans, plus an ambassador tier that rewards top partners with free product and higher commissions.

description: Family-owned natural-remedies brand based in Columbus, Ohio, selling herbal tinctures, powders, salves, soaps and personal-care products made with fully disclosed 100% natural ingredients, and running an 'Earthologist' affiliate program alongside a practitioner wholesale program.

evidence.summary: Earthley's official affiliate page states its Earthologist program pays 15% commission on all sales including personal orders; its FAQ confirms commission starts at 15% and is bumped to 20% after the first $1,000 in sales, paid via PayPal or store credit. No fetched source states any cap on earnings, so the cap is recorded as unknown.

The same official page describes affiliate perks aimed at creators — a support Facebook group, sales and marketing training, early access to new products and product testing before release — and publishes earthologists@earthley.com for affiliate inquiries. The business is family-owned and based in Columbus, OH.

name: Earthley

reasons.compensation: 15% on all sales from day one, rising to 20% after $1,000 in sales — among the better published base rates in natural remedies.
reasons.contact_access: Open sign-up from the official page and a published affiliate-team email (earthologists@earthley.com).
reasons.credibility: Family-owned US business with its own retail store, cGMP-certified and FDA-inspected manufacturing, and fully disclosed ingredients.
reasons.niche_fit: Herbal tinctures and clean family remedies are core natural-health creator content with strong everyday-use storytelling.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are open now; anyone with an Earthley account can apply.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A named affiliate community (Earthologists) with training, a support group, contests and early product access for partners.

name: WishGarden Herbs

reasons.credibility: Operating since 1979, woman-owned and family-run, B Corp certified, with USDA organic and ethically wild-harvested sourcing.

reasons.ugc_evidence: A managed affiliate program with co-branded landing pages, vanity codes on request and a dedicated affiliate manager.

evidence.summary: Wild Wholistic's official affiliate page states affiliates earn 10% commission on every purchase made through their link or code, with an average order over $100, no follower-count requirements, and all applications reviewed personally. The brand frames the program as a community rather than a marketing channel, recruiting wellness creators, herbalists, naturopaths and health coaches who have genuinely used the products, and provides an educational content library for partners. Registration runs through UpPromote.

name: Wild Wholistic

reasons.opportunity_availability: Applications are open now, though approval is selective — applicants must have genuinely used the products.
reasons.ugc_evidence: A deliberately community-run program: personally reviewed applications, no follower minimums, and an education library for partners.
